Subject: POC kickoff: config steps & short unblock session

Hi Sana / Marcus,

Great to meet you both this morning — thanks for walking through the goals for the Luminate POC. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Goal: Validate latency and cost-per-inference for your 8k daily requests pattern; demo caching + prefix warmup.
- Action (Luminate): Provide a representative sample dataset (anonymized) and the expected max sequence lengths by 24 Sep.
- Action (Redwood): Run a short 30-min configuration session to confirm VPC peering and sample runbook; we can do this the week of Sep 28.
- Internal ask: Ben to join the configuration call for the VPC/peering checklist.

I've attached a short POC checklist and a sample PoE config to speed things up (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf, poe-sample-config.yaml). If procurement or security needs anything up front, flag it here and I’ll loop in our security SME.

Proposed slots for the config session: Tue 09/29 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 09/30 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works best?

Thanks — I’ll mark the action items and follow up if I don’t hear back by Friday.

Best,
Marissa
